# Liebherr SmartDevice

> > IoT platform for Liebherr appliances enabling remote control, smart home integration, and intelligent features through the SmartDevice app and SmartDeviceBox.

Liebherr's SmartDevice ecosystem connects refrigeration and cooling appliances to the internet, offering features like remote monitoring, voice control via Alexa, AutoDoor functionality, and BottleTimer. The platform bridges traditional appliances with modern smart home systems through dedicated hardware and mobile applications.

- SmartDevice
- SmartDeviceBox
- SmartDevice app
